deployments_detail.use: Advanced Data Analytics Program that turns production data into optimization scenarios across quality, productivity, energy and raw-material (blend) usage, launched group-wide under the 'Transformation at Work' (İş'te Dönüşüm) 2030 program at Erdemir and İsdemir. [none]

AI-powered new-generation Grab Ship Unloader cranes at İsdemir Port using machine-learning algorithms to analyze real-time crane data; described as first-in-Türkiye port deployment (technology otherwise used only in the US, China, India). Operated by OYAK Denizcilik ve Liman İşletmeleri serving İsdemir. [OYAK Denizcilik ve Liman İşletmeleri (operator)]

AI-based predictive maintenance project on the İsdemir Port cranes that forecasts equipment failures before they occur to reduce downtime, extend asset life and improve occupational safety. [OYAK Denizcilik ve Liman İşletmeleri]

Robotic Process Automation (RPA) deployed to automate repetitive manual back-office tasks, cutting processing time and error rates and redirecting staff to higher-value work, under the 'Transformation at Work' program. [none]
AI in Office Programs (Ofis Programlarında Yapay Zeka Uygulamaları) — generative/office AI assistants rolled out to pilot user groups to embed AI into daily workflows and document/data tasks. [none]

Enterprise SAP digital transformation (ERP structure renewal with real-time data integration, data-driven production/supply-chain operations and predictive-maintenance capability) recognized as SAP Digital Transformation Award of the Year in the Iron & Steel sector at SAP Transformation Awards 2025. [SAP]
